text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026. March 25, 2026 Councillor Burnside, during the morning session of the meeting, gave remarks about the late Shamsh Kara. Councillor Perruzza, during the morning session of the meeting, gave remarks about the late Giorgio Mammoliti. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to address City Council to recognize the Toronto Olympic Medalists from the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics. Mayor Chow addressed City Council and gave remarks to celebrate Olympic Medalists from the Milano-Cortina 2026 Olympics with ties to Toronto.
